name: tool-call
title: Tool Call
summary: One call an agent made to a tool: its name, state and time, opening to the input and the output or error.
use_when: Showing what an agent did, one tool at a time, inside an Agent Run or a Message
Letting people check the exact input and output of a call
avoid_when: A whole task with several steps: use Agent Run around the calls
Logs or long files: link to them instead of printing them

props.name: ReactNode: the tool's name, "Search files"
props.icon: Hugeicons icon for the tool (default CodeIcon); a Spinner replaces it while running
props.value: unknown (ToolCallInput, ToolCallOutput, ToolCallError): strings print as they are, objects as JSON

copy.name: The tool's action in sentence case: "Search files", not "search_files()"

a11y: The row is a button that says whether it is open
State icons carry their state as a label, so the meaning is not colour alone
